about: Theme tokens for the Sticker Diary (DESIGN.md), Phase 1 C1. The single source for the app (palette.ts), the contrast gate (npm run check:contrast) and the VectorCraft swatches, which carry these names. Both themes have the same token names; every pair below is checked in each theme. Floors: 4.5 for text, 3 for large text, icons and non-text UI (Phase 1 plan §4.1). Colours are #RRGGBB, or #RRGGBBAA where a token is translucent.

roles.page: The diary page: the ground of every screen.
roles.paper: Paper fields and list groups that sit on the page, separated by tone and a crisp edge, never a shadow.
roles.field: Inputs, segmented-control tracks and other wells inside paper.
roles.edge: The paper's crisp edge. Decorative: never the only cue for a control.
roles.edgeStrong: Boundaries that identify a control, such as a text input (3:1).
roles.ink: Cocoa: body text, headings, the timer and icons.
roles.inkSoft: Secondary text and icons, tinted from cocoa, never grey.
roles.primary: Strawberry: the primary action's fill. A soft fill, so it carries a dark label.
roles.onPrimary: The label on a primary fill.
roles.primaryInk: Strawberry as text or an icon: links, selected labels, the selected tab.
roles.primarySoft: A selected chip or row, tinted from strawberry.
roles.accent: Tomato: the brand's red, used small and rarely (a badge, the sticker moment). A strong fill, so it carries a light label.
roles.onAccent: The label on a tomato fill.
roles.success: Leaf: goal reached, garden growth. A soft fill with a dark label.
roles.onSuccess: The label on a leaf fill.
roles.successInk: Leaf as text or an icon.
roles.danger: Destructive actions only (reset, delete), kept apart from the brand tomato so the brand colour never means loss.
roles.onDanger: The label on a destructive fill.
roles.ringTrack: The timer ring's unfilled track; also chart baselines.
roles.ringFocus: The ring during focus, and focus data marks in Stats (3:1 on the page and the track).
roles.ringBreak: The ring during a break, and break data marks.
roles.stickerEdge: The die-cut border around every sticker, in both themes. Stickers only, never chrome.
roles.stickerShadow: The sticker's soft, offset shadow, tinted from the theme. Stickers are the only things that lift.
